nodes.label: vollbuild
nodes.rationale: Flask-based club management backend application with PostgreSQL, Redis, and MongoDB integration

nodes.name: vollbuild.models
nodes.definition: SQLAlchemy model package — 25 model files covering club management domain

nodes.name: vollbuild.schemas
nodes.definition: Marshmallow schema package — re-exports validation schemas for all domain models

nodes.name: vollbuild.tasks
nodes.definition: Background task package — mail sync, session maintenance, smoke tests, WildDuck integration

nodes.name: vollbuild.api.version
nodes.definition: Version info API blueprint — returns backend version and health

nodes.name: vollbuild.api.groups
nodes.definition: Groups API blueprint — CRUD for interest/project groups

nodes.name: vollbuild.api.dashboard
nodes.definition: Dashboard API blueprint — statistics and overview data

nodes.name: vollbuild.api.members
nodes.definition: Members API blueprint — member CRUD, profiles, authentication

nodes.name: Member
nodes.definition: Core member/tenant model with password hash (argon2), tier FK, role FK, status, avatar, M:N groups and events

nodes.name: MembershipTier
nodes.definition: Pricing tier with fixed/percentage/formula billing, billing_cycle, color, M:N members

nodes.name: Group
nodes.definition: Interest/project group with lead FK, description, color, icon, tools count, sessions, archival

nodes.name: ClubEvent
nodes.definition: Calendar event with title, date, time, location, type (Workshop/Social/Certification/Meeting), M:N attendees via event_attendees

nodes.name: Application
nodes.definition: Prospective member application with name, email, desired tier FK

nodes.name: Transaction / TransactionCategory / Invoice
nodes.definition: Finance models: transaction with category, member, amount, method, type (income/expense), status; invoice with line items linked to transaction

nodes.name: Role / Permission / RolePermission
nodes.definition: RBAC: Permission master list auto-synced from route decorators; Role with is_admin/is_default; RolePermission join with dual unique constraints

nodes.name: Poll / PollOption / PollVote
nodes.definition: Polling system: question, closes_at, status (open/closed); options with vote_count property; votes per member per option

nodes.name: DeviceSession
nodes.definition: Multi-device login tracking with JTI, IP, user agent, name, revocation support

nodes.name: AuditEntry
nodes.definition: Audit log with actor, action, target type/id, actor info snapshots (name, avatar color)

nodes.name: Setting
nodes.definition: Key-value settings with namespace, sensitivity, validation type, defaults, restricted flag

nodes.name: Translation
nodes.definition: I18n translation with locale+key unique constraint, default_value, needs_attention, is_missing, alias_for

nodes.name: vollbuild.extensions.db
nodes.definition: Flask-SQLAlchemy database instance — shared by all models

hyperedges.label: three_tier_architecture
